aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng explicitly depends_on aws_iam_role.managed_ng, but this dependency is already established implicitly via node_role_arn = aws_iam_role.managed_ng.arn. Remove the explicit depends_on entry.

aws_launch_template.self_managed_ng explicitly depends_on aws_iam_instance_profile.self_managed_ng, but the launch template already references the instance profile implicitly, so the explicit depends_on duplicates an existing dependency.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng launches instances as soon as it is created (Terraform then waits for healthy capacity), but nothing orders it after aws_security_group_rule.cluster_primary_sg_ingress_worker_sgr. If this control-plane ingress rule is applied after nodes launch, kubelet cannot reach the API server and nodes fail to join (ClusterClientRequestTimedOut). Add this rule to the ASG's depends_on.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.control_plane_egress_to_worker_https exists. The control plane needs egress to worker nodes over 443 (logs/exec); without it nodes join but kubectl exec/logs fail until the rule lands. Add the rule to the ASG's depends_on.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.control_plane_egress_to_worker_sgr exists. This rule permits control-plane egress into worker nodes for essential pod-networking/admin traffic; order the ASG after it.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.control_plane_ingress_from_worker_https exists. This rule allows kubelet→API-server traffic on the cluster security group; without it, nodes fail to join the cluster. Add the rule to the ASG's depends_on.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.worker_ingress_from_control_plane_https exists. The control plane must be able to reach kubelet on worker nodes over 443; create this rule before any nodes launch.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.worker_to_worker_sgr exists. Without intra-worker security-group ingress, pod-to-pod networking (CNI) breaks as soon as a second node launches. Add the rule to the ASG's depends_on.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.workers_ingress_cluster_primary_sgr exists. This rule permits the cluster primary security group to reach worker nodes; nodes may launch without it and fail control-plane-initiated checks.

aws_autoscaling_group.self_managed_ng can launch instances before aws_security_group_rule.workers_ingress_control_plane_sgr exists. This rule permits the EKS control plane security group to reach worker nodes; order the ASG after this rule to avoid node join/communication issues.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng provisions worker nodes as soon as it is created, but nothing orders it after aws_security_group_rule.cluster_primary_sg_ingress_worker_sgr. If this control-plane ingress rule is applied after nodes launch, kubelet cannot reach the API server and nodes fail to join (ClusterClientRequestTimedOut). Add the rule to the node group's depends_on.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.control_plane_egress_to_worker_https exists. Control-plane egress to workers over 443 is required for kubectl exec/logs; create the rule before the node group.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.control_plane_egress_to_worker_sgr exists. This rule permits control-plane egress into worker nodes for essential pod-networking/admin traffic; order the node group after it.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.control_plane_ingress_from_worker_https exists. This rule allows kubelet→API-server traffic on the cluster security group; without it, nodes fail to join the cluster. Add the rule to the node group's depends_on.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.worker_ingress_from_control_plane_https exists. The control plane must be able to reach kubelet on worker nodes over 443; create this rule before nodes launch.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.worker_to_worker_sgr exists. Without intra-worker security-group ingress, pod-to-pod networking (CNI) breaks as soon as a second node launches. Add the rule to the node group's depends_on.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.workers_ingress_cluster_primary_sgr exists. This rule permits the cluster primary security group to reach worker nodes; nodes may launch without it and fail control-plane-initiated checks.

aws_eks_node_group.managed_ng can provision nodes before aws_security_group_rule.workers_ingress_control_plane_sgr exists. This rule permits the EKS control plane security group to reach worker nodes; order the node group after this rule to avoid node join/communication issues.
